blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The arraignment of Vice President Sara Duterte on three counts of grave threats was postponed for the second time on Friday by the Quezon City Regional Trial Court Branch 98. The arraignment was initially scheduled for Sept. 11 before the court moved it to Oct. 9. The court’s latest postponement delays the proceedings in the case stemming from Duterte’s remarks during an online press conference in November 2024, when she said she had hired a hitman to target President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., First Lady Liza Araneta-Marcos, and former House Speaker Martin Romualdez if she herself were killed.
